summary: Platform-specific prebuilt binary package with no observed installer-harm behavior
details: Package @pkgship/frpc-linux-arm64 is a platform-specific distribution (linux-arm64) consistent with the common pattern of shipping a prebuilt native binary (frpc, a well-known reverse-proxy client) for a parent package to select via optionalDependencies at install time. No lifecycle scripts, remote fetch-and-execute, credential access, environment scraping, or network callbacks were observed in the two files scanned. The package's only install-time effect is placing a prebuilt binary on disk; it is not auto-executed by npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
